description: This is a Java test class for the LoanProduct domain, containing JUnit 5 test cases that validate various rules and behaviors of LoanProduct objects, especially related to DaysInYear strategies and loan schedule types.

classes.name: LoanProductTest
classes.description: JUnit test class containing unit tests for validating LoanProduct rules related to DaysInYear strategies and LoanScheduleType constraints.

methods.name: testCanCreateLoanProductWithDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Tests successful creation of a LoanProduct with a custom days-in-year strategy when using a PROGRESSIVE schedule type.

methods.name: testValidationExceptionForCreateCumulativeLoanProductWithDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when trying to create a CUMULATIVE schedule LoanProduct with a custom days-in-year strategy, which is invalid.

methods.name: testValidationExceptionForCreate360LoanProductWithDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Checks that an exception is thrown if a PROGRESSIVE schedule LoanProduct is created with a days-in-year value of 360 and a custom strategy, which is invalid.

methods.name: testCanCreate360LoanProductWithoutDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Verifies that creating a PROGRESSIVE schedule LoanProduct with a days-in-year value of 360 without a custom strategy proceeds successfully.
